name: sme-panel-pack-fused-unroll4
hypothesis: The baseline passed, but its 620–1059 GFLOP/s spread does not establish stable performance. Packing one A row panel in k-major order should reduce strided loads and keep that panel in cache while all column blocks consume it. One streaming region handles both packing and multiplication; full tiles use all-active predicates and four-way k unrolling. This is an unmeasured candidate, not a claim that the target is met.
